Default design converges to a constrained stall after 12 accepted steps:

  • Objective: 0.955903 → 2.191525 (+129.3%).
  • All geometry invariants remain valid.
  • Target clearance reaches 0.100241 μm, just above the 0.10 μm constraint.
  • Thirteenth attempt returns the same state and “No improving step fits here.”
  • Total improve() execution: 827 ms on this Mac, excluding field rendering.

Use unchanged geometry or an explicit accepted: false as the automatic stopping condition. Keep the existing reason visible; do not call boundary stalls proven convergence. Avoid a percentage-gain cutoff: improvements briefly fall below 0.5%, then later rise to 2.06%.

Read-only investigation; no files, Git, PRs or comments changed.

Two concrete findings:

  1. API single steps inherited stale run counters/baseline; your shared singleStep() fixes this.
  2. Accepted steps rebuild the focused Run/Pause button. Confirmed in real Chrome: after keyboard-starting Run, first accepted step moves focus to BODY, preventing keyboard pause. Preserve that button’s focus across rebuilding.

No additional scheduling/cancellation bug found. Default motion remains valid at 101 sampled intermediate positions per accepted step. Read-only review; no files or Git state changed.
